programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The Windsor family finally gets its turn at an intake shootout!

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys debate if a solid roller camshaft is worth the extra money.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: We run our LS with factory exhaust manifolds and again with turbo headers.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys deliberately heat and cool fuel to see the difference it makes.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys find out if Max Wedge heads are really a worthwhile upgrade.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: We find out whether header wraps really do create more power.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys test out a bunch of Holley's "Ram" intakes on their 6.2-liter LS.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: We test six manifolds with our old-school carb and our new-school 6.0 LS.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys see if exhaust cutouts do more than rattle passersby's eardrums.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The crew super-tunes every HP out of the 410 Windsor from the Disgustang.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys test out three low-buck cylinder heads on a 383 small-block Chevy.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys test how different carb features affect horsepower and tunability.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys challenge their previous findings testing single-pattern cams.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys see if too much oil pressure robs precious horsepower.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys try to boost an 800-horspower 572 up to a comfortable 950+.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys shoot out six packs on a 440 to see which makes the most power.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.sub-title: Magic of the Flex Fuel Sensor
programme.desc: The guys figure out how to make more power with a flex fuel engine.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys see whether boost and vacuum leaks actually affect power.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys see how wet and dry nitrous systems stack up on an EFI manifold.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: Multipoint EFI gets its turn against the venerable Dominator.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: A supercharged medium-sized mill takes on a naturally aspirated big block.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The crew pits a four-barrel carb against dual quads on the tunnel ram.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.sub-title: How Hard Can a Hardtop Be?
programme.desc: A 1971 Chevy Nova with tremendous pedigree arrives at the shop to get classic Kindig-It styling cues; Dave wants to make this car into a hardtop; tucked-in bumpers, front valance and a new engine provide a good test for the crew.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Will makes miracles happen, and Dave decides to make a wholesale change to the car's color; challenges mount at each stage of the build, and the upholstery shop changes up their routine as the client arrives for a reveal years in the making.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: While the shop perfects its process in building the CF1s, word about the car spreads and potential buyers line up; the latest client has a big problem when he can't choose the perfect color combination.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave and Kev take the show to the Midwest, as more than 2,500 cars descend on the Summit Motorsports drag strip for a weekend of fun; Kev gets a ride in a lean, mean drag racing machine; Dave steps up his autocross game.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A client enlists Dave on a mission from God to make his dreams of a father/son road trip along Route 66 come true; getting the client's mechanically unsound reproduction of the Bluesmobile ready for the road will test the crew's mettle.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Kevin Schiele breathes new life into a semi-hauler by giving it a visual and functional upgrade that impeccably reflects his expertise in trucks.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Training the next-generation car builders is near and dear to Dave's heart, and after years of planning, he's finally realized his passion project, the Kindig Academy.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.sub-title: Is There Anything Good on It?
programme.desc: A 1969 Camaro comes in; when Dave and team get a closer look, they determine with the owner that it requires a full rebuild; since the team will be starting from scratch, the client decides to go all-out on the chassis, engine and details.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: With the Camaro's design firmed up, the build continues, but hits a roadblock when it comes to getting the engine dialed in just right; Dave has second thoughts about the color combination.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.sub-title: There's a Bolt in My Motor
programme.desc: A simple engine repair slowly turns into a patented Kindig slippery slope, as a show-ready 1935 Roadster V8 requires a full rebuild.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The shop hits the road to check out the competition; Will and Dave's cousin Brad comes along for the ride to share their view on the cars they come across; they team up to challenge Dave in an autocross.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The 1955 Nomad is an iconic car, but the original power isn't enough for the current owner, who wants the guys to put a blower on to boost the power; a new project for a secret client arrives in pretty rough shape, but emerges ready to rumble.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A new client, Rick Mezich from "Deadliest Catch," tests Dave's design prowess on his CF1, while the upholstery shop shows off some of the new processes it has developed to streamline the builds.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Off-road vehicles are few and far between at the shop, but when they do arrive, Dave and the guys love to go all out; this particular Hummer gets a huge conversion from two-wheel drive to four-wheel, a new LS engine, interior and a fresh paint job.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The shop has a busy week prepping for the 2022 SEMA show in Las Vegas, Nevada; once in Vegas, Dave and Kev attend the first-ever concours d'elegance at the famous Wynn hotel and golf course, where their knowledge of cars will be pushed to its limits.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: As the workshop buzzes with activities, the latest CF1 becomes a new challenge for the team, as Dave makes alterations to the original.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Scottsdale is about to witness one of the fiercest competitions at the last car show of the year; Dave gets all the help he needs with his toolbox.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The shop preps for the 2022 SEMA show in Las Vegas; Dave and Kev attend the first concours d'elegance, which pushes their knowledge of cars to the limits.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Getting the hood just right proves tricky and the guys invent a new process to make it work; the body work on this truck is where the art of the build truly comes out.

programme.title: Secret Nazi Planes
programme.desc: During WWII, Germany explored every option of striking the US; they considered submarines, rockets from space, and the mighty 4-engine bomber program that became known as the Amerika Bomber.

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: An architect (Steve Martin) has a girlfriend (Dana Delany) who won't move into his house and a dizzy woman (Goldie Hawn) who won't move out.","large":"Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: A middle-class man (Steve Martin), his wife (Mary Steenburgen), his father and a divorcee (Dianne Wiest) try to be good parents.","large":"Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression, a doctor, once a psychiatric patient, uses humor and unconventional methods in his practice.","large":"After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: An aspiring filmmaker (Winona Ryder) follows the paths of her friends after they graduate from college in Texas.","large":"After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: A woman (Kate Hudson) takes a job as a hospice nurse for a couple (Gena Rowlands, John Hurt) who live in a New Orleans house with a troublesome history.","large":"Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: After their daughter is assaulted and left for dead, a couple (Tony Goldwyn, Monica Potter) take revenge on the assailants, who have taken shelter at the couple's house.","large":"Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Sent by an evil queen (Charlize Theron) to capture an escaped princess (Kristen Stewart), a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) instead becomes the young woman's protector and helps her in her quest to regain control of her kingdom.","large":"Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: A nobleman (Anthony Hopkins) contends with an ancient curse, scouring his childhood homeland for his missing brother, while a bloodthirsty beast prowls the moors.","large":"Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: The mummified body of Imhotep is shipped to a museum in London, where he once again wakes and begins his campaign of rage and terror.","large":"Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: After his son is tricked into awakening a cursed Chinese emperor, Rick O'Connell and his family seek a way to send the megalomaniac and his 10,000 warriors back to their graves.","large":"Cursed by a devious sorceress, China's ruthless Dragon Emperor (Jet Li) and his vast army lie buried in clay for millennia. When young archaeologist Alex O'Connell is tricked into reviving the emperor, he and his famous parents (Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello) must find a way to send the ghoul back to the grave before he can awaken his vast army and take over the world.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge, is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach.","large":"A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy and his team face an underworld prince who plans to awaken a lethal army and use it to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred.","large":"Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: Paranoia spreads among a team of Arctic researchers as they battle a deadly alien organism that assumes the shapes of its victims.","large":"After Norwegian researchers discover an alien ship buried in the ice, paleontologist Kate Lloyd (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) joins the team at the isolated Arctic outpost to investigate. She finds an organism that appears to have perished in the crash eons ago but, in fact, is about to awake. Freed from its icy prison, the insidious life-form goes on the attack. Paranoia spreads like wildfire among the crew as they fight to survive against a creature that assumes the shapes of its victims.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: A woman and her 9-year-old twin sons encounter the evil spirit of Bughuul in a rural house that's marked for death.","large":"Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: The Purge
programme.desc: A wealthy family is held hostage for harboring the target of a murderous syndicate during the Purge, a 12-hour period in which any and all crime is legal.","large":"In an America ravaged by crime and overcrowded prisons, the government sanctions an annual 12-hour period during which all criminal activity -- including murder -- is legal. James Sandin and his family face the ultimate test when an intruder drags the vicious outside world into their home. James, Mary and their two children struggle to survive the night while trying not to turn into monsters like the ones they are striving to avoid.

programme.title: The Purge: Election Year
programme.desc: Former Police Sergeant Barnes becomes head of security for Senator Charlie Roan, a Presidential candidate targeted for death on Purge night due to her vow to eliminate the Purge.","large":"As a young woman, Sen. Charlie Roan survived the annual night of lawlessness that took the lives of her family members. As a presidential candidate, Roan is determined to end the yearly tradition of bloodlust once and for all. When her opponents hatch a deadly scheme, the senator finds herself trapped on the streets of Washington, D.C., just as the latest Purge gets underway. Now, it's up to Leo Barnes, her head of security, to keep her alive during the next 12 hours of mayhem.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: George Lucas' tale of an extraterrestrial duck who is mistakenly brought to Cleveland by an experimental laser beam.","large":"In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: A suburban homeowner's vacation with his wife becomes a horror after some odd neighbors move in next door.","large":"Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: An irresponsible playboy becomes emotionally attached to a woman's12-year-old son. The man and child help each other in an unlikely friendship.","large":"A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: A nursing-home resident (Jessica Tandy) regales a visitor (Kathy Bates) with tales of the close friendship between two women in the 1930s Alabama.","large":"On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: A middle-class man (Steve Martin), his wife (Mary Steenburgen), his father and a divorcee (Dianne Wiest) try to be good parents.","large":"Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: An architect (Steve Martin) has a girlfriend (Dana Delany) who won't move into his house and a dizzy woman (Goldie Hawn) who won't move out.","large":"Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: A police detective (James Belushi) with a girlfriend (Mel Harris) gets stuck with a new partner, a German shepherd dog.","large":"Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression, a doctor, once a psychiatric patient, uses humor and unconventional methods in his practice.","large":"After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: An aspiring filmmaker (Winona Ryder) follows the paths of her friends after they graduate from college in Texas.","large":"After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: A woman (Kate Hudson) takes a job as a hospice nurse for a couple (Gena Rowlands, John Hurt) who live in a New Orleans house with a troublesome history.","large":"Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: After their daughter is assaulted and left for dead, a couple (Tony Goldwyn, Monica Potter) take revenge on the assailants, who have taken shelter at the couple's house.","large":"Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge, is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach.","large":"A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Sent by an evil queen (Charlize Theron) to capture an escaped princess (Kristen Stewart), a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) instead becomes the young woman's protector and helps her in her quest to regain control of her kingdom.","large":"Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: A nobleman (Anthony Hopkins) contends with an ancient curse, scouring his childhood homeland for his missing brother, while a bloodthirsty beast prowls the moors.","large":"Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: A woman and her 9-year-old twin sons encounter the evil spirit of Bughuul in a rural house that's marked for death.","large":"Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: The Purge
programme.desc: A wealthy family is held hostage for harboring the target of a murderous syndicate during the Purge, a 12-hour period in which any and all crime is legal.","large":"In an America ravaged by crime and overcrowded prisons, the government sanctions an annual 12-hour period during which all criminal activity -- including murder -- is legal. James Sandin and his family face the ultimate test when an intruder drags the vicious outside world into their home. James, Mary and their two children struggle to survive the night while trying not to turn into monsters like the ones they are striving to avoid.

programme.title: The Purge: Election Year
programme.desc: Former Police Sergeant Barnes becomes head of security for Senator Charlie Roan, a Presidential candidate targeted for death on Purge night due to her vow to eliminate the Purge.","large":"As a young woman, Sen. Charlie Roan survived the annual night of lawlessness that took the lives of her family members. As a presidential candidate, Roan is determined to end the yearly tradition of bloodlust once and for all. When her opponents hatch a deadly scheme, the senator finds herself trapped on the streets of Washington, D.C., just as the latest Purge gets underway. Now, it's up to Leo Barnes, her head of security, to keep her alive during the next 12 hours of mayhem.

programme.title: The Good, the Bad, the Weird
programme.desc: In the 1930s Manchuria, an encounter on a train triggers an epic crusade for a treasure map, prompting a marathon chase in hot pursuit of the loot. Do-won, "The Good", is a bounty hunter, out to track down Chang-yee, "The Bad", a charismatic hit man attempting to steal the map from a military official. However, the ruthless Tae-goo puts a hitch in both their plans when he secures the map for himself.

programme.title: Cherry Falls
programme.desc: A serial killer stalking virgins in a small Virginia town targets an idealistic teenager (Brittany Murphy).","large":"A small-town sheriff, Brent Marken (Michael Biehn), discovers the presence of a serial killer in his sleepy hamlet. Since the perpetrator has been targeting only virgins, both male and female, the deaths cause panic in much of the local high school population. Sheriff Marken's daughter, Jody (Brittany Murphy), is among the potential victims, since she has yet to sleep with her boyfriend, Kenny Ascott (Gabriel Mann). Can the lawman stop the killer before he goes after Jody?

programme.title: Cry Wolf
programme.desc: Mysterious murders occur when students (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) at a prep school invent a story about a serial killer.

programme.title: Cucuy: The Boogeyman
programme.desc: A teenage girl under house arrest discovers that the nightmarish urban legend of the Mexican boogeyman, El Cucuy, is true.

programme.title: The Darkness
programme.desc: A supernatural force terrorizes a couple (Kevin Bacon, Radha Mitchell) and their two children after the young son brings home some mysterious rocks from the Grand Canyon.","large":"Peter Taylor (Kevin Bacon), his wife Bronny and their two children return to Los Angeles after a fun-filled vacation to the Grand Canyon. Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

programme.title: Dead in the Water
programme.desc: An all-female crew, on a boat in the middle of nowhere, must deal with an invader on their ship.

programme.title: Dead Man's Eyes
programme.desc: Blinded by acid thanks to his jealous model, an artist (Lon Chaney) needs eye tissue for an operation.

programme.title: Delirium
programme.desc: A man inherits a haunted house after spending time in a mental institution.

programme.title: Dementia 13
programme.desc: A mysterious masked killer terrorizes members of a family at a secluded estate.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: While investigating the disappearance of her twin sister, a young American encounters the tormented spirits of Japan's mysterious and legendary Aokigahara Forest.","large":"When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Games
programme.desc: A mysterious woman (Simone Signoret) in black moves in with married Manhattan thrill-seekers (James Caan, Katharine Ross) and helps one trick the other.","large":"Wealthy and bored, Paul (James Caan) and Jennifer Montgomery (Katharine Ross) while away their hours in a New York City apartment filled with pinball machines and other amusements. The couple's routine is upended when door-to-door saleswoman Lisa Schindler (Simone Signoret) drops by and is suddenly taken ill. The Montgomerys let her spend the night. And soon, the sophisticated Lisa and her hosts embark on a new set of very adult -- and very dangerous -- games.

programme.title: Gone
programme.desc: A televangelist (Gregory Itzin) influences a confrontational man (Billy Burke) motivated by revenge.

programme.title: The Green Inferno
programme.desc: Student activists (Lorenza Izzo, Ariel Levy) crash-land in the Amazon and encounter an indigenous tribe of cannibals who'd like to have them for dinner.","large":"New York college student Justine (Lorenza Izzo), a lawyer's daughter, meets a student activist named Alejandro (Ariel Levy) when he goes on a hunger strike on behalf of underpaid janitors. Smitten, Justine agrees to help Alejandro undertake his next project: to save the Amazon. She soon learns to regret her decision when their plane crashes in the Peruvian jungle and she and the rest of their group are taken captive by a tribe of hungry cannibals.

programme.title: The Guardian
programme.desc: Yuppies (Dwier Brown, Carey Lowell) with a baby hire a nanny (Jenny Seagrove), a druid witch who sacrifices babies to a tree.","large":"Optimistic about their future, well-off parents Kate (Carey Lowell) and Phil (Dwier Brown) hire the pleasant and lovely young Camilla (Jenny Seagrove) to live with them and care for their new baby. Though Camilla seems like an answer to their prayers, she proves to be more than she appears, and a diabolical plot involving the wellbeing of their child is uncovered. The young parents are forced to fight supernatural forces for the life of their vulnerable offspring.

programme.title: I Saw What You Did
programme.desc: Two teenage girls, bored while baby-sitting, make prank phone calls, completely unaware one of the people on the other end of the line has just killed his wife and now thinks the girls must be silenced.","large":"Kit (Sarah Lane) and her best friend, Libby (Andi Garrett), are two teenage girls bored while baby-sitting. To pass the time, they make prank phone calls, telling the person on the other end of the line, "I saw what you did, and I know who you are!" It's all in good fun, until they call a man (John Ireland) who just murdered his wife and buried her in the woods. Convinced they actually do know his secret, he becomes determined to find out who they are and silence them forever.

programme.title: Incarnate
programme.desc: Recruited by a Vatican emissary (Catalina Sandino Moreno), an exorcist (Aaron Eckhart) taps into the subconscious mind of a tormented boy (David Mazouz) to free him from demonic possession.","large":"After a single mother witnesses terrifying symptoms of demonic possession in her 11-year-old son (David Mazouz), a Vatican representative calls on wheelchair-bound scientist Dr. Seth Ember (Aaron Eckhart) to rid him of the evil spirit. Driven by a personal agenda rooted in his own tragic past, Ember enters the boy's unconscious mind where he confronts a demon as ferocious as it is ingenious.

programme.title: The Keeping Hours
programme.desc: A lawyer sees the ghost of his dead son, which leads the man's estranged wife back into his life.

programme.title: Killer High
programme.desc: Sabrina's perfectly planned high school reunion goes south when a monster keeps killing all the guests.

programme.title: Boogeyman
programme.desc: Mike (Eddie McClintock), the town sheriff, has to battle the mythical Boogeyman after boys accidentally release it.

programme.title: Long Time Dead
programme.desc: A genie terrorizes London students (Lara Belmont, Melanie Gutteridge) after they unwittingly summon it with a Ouija.","large":"After a long night of dancing and drinking their way into a haze, roommates Rob (Joe Absolom), Liam (Alec Newman), Stella (Lara Belmont) and Spencer (James Hillier) and a few of their friends duck into a back room of the nightclub to play around with a Ouija board. None of the friends like what the board tells them: they will all die that night. Sure enough, one by one the young friends are slaughtered by a malevolent killer, amid revelations about satanic worship and sacrifice.

programme.title: The New Daughter
programme.desc: A single father (Kevin Costner) is puzzled by his daughter's (Ivana Baquero) weird behavior, which begins soon after he moves his family to a secluded woodland home.

programme.title: Nightmare
programme.desc: A guardian (David Knight) and his lover (Moira Redmond) stage grim scenes to drive a haunted English heiress (Jennie Linden) mad.

programme.title: Not Safe for Work
programme.desc: An office worker becomes trapped in a building with a killer.

programme.title: Phantasm II
programme.desc: Two psychically linked teens (James LeGros, Paula Irvine) cannot escape from the grave-robbing Tall Man of their nightmares.","large":"Years after surviving his encounter with the sinister Tall Man (Angus Scrimm), Mike Pearson (James LeGros), now a mental patient, still has nightmares about the evil gaunt mortician. Upon being released from the institution, Mike and his friend Reggie (Reggie Bannister) set out to track down the Tall Man and end his murderous and macabre practices. Also involved is Liz Reynolds (Paula Irvine), a pretty young woman who has a psychic connection to both Mike and the Tall Man.

programme.title: Rosewood Lane
programme.desc: Sonny Blake (Rose McGowan), a radio talk show therapist, moves back to her childhood home after her father dies. She is shocked to learn her neighbors are terrified of the paperboy (Daniel Ross Owens) who turns out to be a dangerous sociopath.

programme.title: Saint Ange
programme.desc: Strange events haunt a pregnant woman (Virginie Ledoyen) and others at a recently vacated orphanage in the French Alps.","large":"Anna is a cleaning woman who accepts a post at the St. Ange Orphanage. She arrives to confront an unsettling lack of orphans, save for one who acts far too childish for her age. Then the bizarre sights and sounds begin, which seem to elude detection by the only other servant or the gloomy institution's director. Is this all in Anna's mind? Or does something more sinister lurk in the heart of St. Ange?

programme.title: Session 9
programme.desc: Asbestos removal crews start work in an abandoned insane asylum, and strange happenings begin to occur.","large":"A tale of terror when a group of asbestos removal workers start work in an abandoned insane asylum. The complex of buildings looms up out of the woods like a dormant beast. Grand, imposing, abandoned, deteriorating. The residents of Danvers, Massachusetts, steer well clear of the place. But Danvers State Mental Hospital, closed down for 15 years, is about to receive five new visitors.

programme.title: SiREN
programme.desc: A man visits a supernatural nightclub during his bachelor party and inadvertently crosses paths with a dancer who is actually a terrifying, legendary creature.","large":"One week before his wedding day, Jonah and his groomsmen hit the town for a wild night of club hopping and debauchery. The night soon takes a twisted turn for the worse when the group is invited to a seedy underground club. After Jonah frees a seemingly imprisoned dancer, he realizes that the woman he released is actually a terrifying, legendary creature that will stop at nothing to claim her prey.

programme.title: The Skulls
programme.desc: A freshman (Joshua Jackson) joins an elite society that will guarantee him success, but he questions his decision when his reporter roommate dies mysteriously.","large":"For Luke McNamara (Joshua Jackson), an invitation to join the prestigious secret college organization, The Skulls, is a dream come true. But he soon comes to realize just how powerful The Skulls organization really is -- and that the truth, like success, comes at a very high price.

programme.title: The Skulls II
programme.desc: A new inductee (Robin Dunne) into the secret society witnesses a murder at the hands of one of its members.","large":"The Skulls, a secret college society whose influence reaches the highest levels of government and business, recruit Ryan Sommers (Robin Dunne), whose future success now seems all but assured. Then one day he sees one of his fraternity brothers kill a young woman -- a crime that Ryan must keep secret if he is to remain a Skull. While Kelly (Lindy Booth), a good friend, pushes him to follow his conscience, Ryan's girlfriend, Ali (Ashley Lyn Cafagna), surprises him by being against his snitching.

programme.title: The Skulls III
programme.desc: A young woman (Clare Kramer) gets more than she bargained for when she gains entrance to a males-only secret society.","large":"In this sequel, beautiful and determined college student Taylor Brooks (Clare Kramer) is intent on joining the secret society known as the Skulls, despite its history of being an organization consisting solely of men. Although she encounters strong resistance, Taylor takes steps toward being accepted into their ranks, but her efforts are derailed when her boyfriend is found dead. Taylor is considered the prime suspect. Can she clear her name and track down the real murderer?

programme.title: The Spider Woman Strikes Back
programme.desc: She (Gale Sondergaard) and her hulking servant grow bloodsucking plants, as a young woman (Brenda Joyce) finds out.

programme.title: Stephanie
programme.desc: After a mysterious global catastrophe, a young girl is left alone to hide from a malevolent power that stalks her home.","large":"A young girl is left alone in her house during a worldwide catastrophe and fearfully hides from a malevolent force that is stalking her. When her parents miraculously return, they try to settle back into normal life, but become increasingly concerned about something that has affected their daughter Stephanie.

programme.title: Virus
programme.desc: Passengers (Jamie Lee Curtis, William Baldwin, Donald Sutherland) on a sinking ship board a seemingly deserted Russian vessel containing a mutating alien force.","large":"Caught in a typhoon, a tugboat commanded by Robert Everton (Donald Sutherland) comes across a mysterious near-deserted ship. Excited to find a vessel that could be sold for as much as $30 million, Everton and his crew board and prepare to move the craft, despite the warnings of sole survivor Nadia Vinogradova (Joanna Pacula). When a malevolent alien presence begins killing off the crew, navigator Kit Foster (Jamie Lee Curtis) tries to convince the rest of them to leave before it's too late.

programme.title: Visions
programme.desc: After moving to a vineyard with her family, a pregnant woman experiences horrifying visions.

programme.title: Wer
programme.desc: In France, an American female attorney (A.J. Cook) defends a murder suspect who has a brutish appearance and a deadly secret.

programme.title: White Noise 2: The Light
programme.desc: After nearly being killed along with his family, a man recovers and realizes that he can sense when someone is about to die.","large":"A man's family is killed, but he survives -- barely. After recovering, he realizes that he has changed in some way: He now senses when someone is about to die. In his attempts to save people who are near death, he discovers there is a price to pay for interfering with the cosmos.

programme.title: Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas
programme.desc: Based on the beloved children's book by Dr. Seuss, "How the Grinch Stole Christmas" follows the exploits of the title character who is infuriated by the celebration he sees down in Whoville each year at Christmastime. He vows to stop it and -- dressed as Santa -- drives a sleigh into town on Christmas Eve, removing all traces of the impending celebration. He watches gleefully from his perch on the mountain above, sure that when the Whos awake and see that their holiday decorations, gifts and feast are gone, they will be sad. To his surprise, the Whos celebrate anyway, leading to an unexpected response from the Grinch.

programme.desc: Serie documental construida a partir de documentos, pinturas, fotografías y filmaciones que dan cuenta de la vida, el contexto y el proceso artístico de Siqueiros, autor reconocido durante el siglo XX.

programme.title: Crónicas de barrio
programme.desc: La Zona Rosa fue desde sus inicios un espacio alternativo y de diversidad; intelectuales, artistas y todo aquel que buscaba un lugar con estas características visitaban este barrio.

programme.title: TAP: Taller de actores profesionales
programme.desc: En este espacio se sostienen reveladoras conversaciones con actores mexicanos, de distintos perfiles y generaciones, quienes hablan sobre sus experiencias en la industria del teatro y la televisión.

programme.title: Punto de referencia - Tu noticiero
programme.desc: Un espacio noticiosos que aborda los hechos más destacados de la agenda de noticias nacional. El espacio está conducido por los periodistas Azul Alzaga y Alberto Nájar y busca informar al público sobre los acontecimientos diarios.

programme.title: Masiosare
programme.desc: Un espacio de debate donde se discutirán los temas que más importan al país.

programme.title: Victor Frankenstein
programme.desc: El científico Victor Frankenstein y su brillante protegido, Igor Strausman, comparten la noble misión de ayudar a la humanidad a partir de una detonante investigación sobre la inmortalidad. Sin embargo, las cosas no saldrán como esperaban.

programme.title: El menú
programme.desc: Una joven pareja viaja a una exclusiva isla para degustar el menú de un chef mundialmente aclamado. Sin embargo, el chef ha introducido un ingrediente secreto que sorprenderá a los comensales.

programme.title: Negra Navidad
programme.desc: Un grupo de alumnas es acosado por un extraño durante sus vacaciones de Navidad. Eso es hasta que la joven hermandad de mujeres descubre que el asesino es parte de una conspiración clandestina de la universidad.

programme.title: Al otro lado del río y entre los árboles
programme.desc: Richard Cantwell es un coronel del ejército estadounidense atormentado por la guerra, que se enfrenta a la noticia de que padece una enfermedad terminal con estoica indiferencia.

programme.title: Hoy se arregla el mundo
programme.desc: Un hombre se entera que no es el padre biológico de su hijo de nueve años y decide ayudar al niño a encontrar a su verdadero papá.

programme.title: Terapia del amor
programme.desc: Darla, una controvertida columnista de una revista, pierde su trabajo debido a su adicción al sexo. Para controlar su adicción, Darla decide que la mejor terapia es recrear toda su historia sexual.

programme.title: Harriet
programme.desc: Basada en la emocionante vida de un ícono de la lucha por la libertad, cuenta la historia extraordinaria del escape de Harriet Tubman de la esclavitud y su transformación en una de las heroínas más grandes de los EE.UU.

programme.title: Recién casados
programme.desc: Para sorpresa de los amigos de Tom y la consternación de la familia de Sarah, ambos se enamoraron instantáneamente. La luna de miel, gracias al ex-novio de Sarah y a una inexplicable racha de mala suerte, se torna catastrófica.

programme.title: Mamá se va de viaje
programme.desc: Tras decirle a su esposa que sueña con la vida fácil que ella lleva en la casa, la mujer decide tomarse vacaciones para demostrarle lo contrario, por lo que Antoine tendrá que cuidar a los niños durante diez días.

programme.title: Música, glamour y fama
programme.desc: Cuando la superestrella Grace Davis tiene la oportunidad de alterar el rumbo de su carrera, junto con su asistente Maggie comienzan a urdir un complicado plan con el que están decididas a cambiar para siempre sus vidas.

programme.title: Agentes del desorden
programme.desc: Cuando dos amigos se visten como agentes de policía para una fiesta de disfraces, se convierten en la sensación del barrio y deciden aprovechar al máximo su falsa autoridad. Todo se complica cuando quedan en medio de una situación mafiosa.

programme.title: El más buscado
programme.desc: Daniel Léger es un antiguo adicto a la heroína que se ve involucrado en un negocio de drogas con la gente equivocada y por los motivos equivocados.

programme.title: Una ciudad despiadada
programme.desc: El paso del huracán Katrina destruyó las viviendas y las vidas de cuatro amigos de la infancia de un barrio marginal. Desesperados, aceptan a regañadientes la oferta de un gángster para llevar a cabo un peligroso atraco en Nueva Orleans.

programme.title: Reefa
programme.desc: Israel "Reefa" Hernandez Jr, un inmigrante colombiano de 18 años que tiene bastante talento artístico, está pasando el verano en Miami. Pero todo cambia cuando después de hacer un grafiti en una pared, Israel se topa con un policía.

programme.title: Yo, traidor
programme.desc: Máximo Ferradas, hijo menor de una poderosa familia de pescadores, reclama su parte de la herencia. Así, comienza un largo viaje que lo llevará hacia tierras lejanas, intentando construir su propio imperio.

programme.title: Un cumpleaños problemático
programme.desc: Un grupo de amigos de toda la vida se reúne para celebrar una pequeña fiesta por el cumpleaños de Frank, en la localidad de Palm Beach. Será un fin de semana de risas, charlas y diversión hasta que la realidad comience a imponerse.

programme.title: Un amor inquebrantable
programme.desc: Joyce Smith y su familia creían que lo habían perdido todo cuando su hijo John cayó en un helado lago. Joyce no estaba dispuesta a renunciar por su hijo, y clamó a Dios por su salvación. Milagrosamente, el corazón de John volvió a latir.

programme.title: En sus zapatos
programme.desc: Maggie y Rose, dos hermanas que no tienen nada en común, coinciden por primera vez en algo ¡se enamoraron de la misma persona!. Sólo con la ayuda de la abuela que creían muerta, lograrán descubrir el significado del amor filial.

programme.title: Ophelia
programme.desc: Ophelia, es una joven e impetuosa adolescente que reside en el castillo de Elsinore como una de las personas de confianza de la Reina Gertrude. Su personalidad no pasa desapercibida ante los ojos del Príncipe Hamlet.

programme.title: La noche de su vida
programme.desc: Una atractiva animadora se convierte en objeto de las obsesiones románticas de un sabiondo friki. A partir del momento en que él le declara su amor a través de su discurso de graduación, ambos se verán envueltos en una desventura.

programme.title: Victor Frankenstein
programme.desc: El científico Victor Frankenstein y su brillante protegido, Igor Strausman, comparten la noble misión de ayudar a la humanidad a partir de una detonante investigación sobre la inmortalidad. Sin embargo, las cosas no saldrán como esperaban.

programme.title: Choque de opiniones
programme.sub-title: Analizamos el intento fallido de someter a juicio político al secretario de defensa
programme.desc: Prepárate a vivir el debate político más interesante de la televisión. Aquí confrontarán los puntos de vista opuestos sobre temas claves de Estados Unidos en la región. Un debate marcado por el rigor, la pasión y la veracidad.

programme.title: CNN FlashDoc
programme.desc: Cuando Facebook se lanzó en 2004, cambió nuestro mundo. De repente, podíamos conectar con cualquier persona, en cualquier lugar.

programme.title: Oppenheimer presenta
programme.sub-title: Posibles candidatos presidenciales de EE. UU. en 2028 tras la ola demócrata
programme.desc: Todas las historias tienen dos lados, algunas veces más. Oppenheimer los presenta todos en este espacio de análisis inteligente sobre los temas más relevantes de la actualidad política, económica y social.

programme.title: México opina
programme.sub-title: Crisis de agua potable en Latinoamérica

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo: solo
programme.desc: Shanika y James comienzan su desafío en solitario de 21 días. Mientras, devastada por los insectos, Terra considera volver a buscar el iniciador de fuego.

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo: solo
programme.desc: Jamie teme tener un parásito en la vejiga. Fernando cambia de estrategia de caza y James se encuentra con hipopótamos agresivos en su nueva fuente de agua.

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo
programme.desc: Cuatro supervivientes buscan redimirse de sus fracasos pasados. Sin embargo, sus promesas de sobrevivir 21 días en un remoto lago filipino se ponen a prueba cuando ingieren accidentalmente una sustancia tóxica.

programme.title: Desolado con Ed Stafford
programme.desc: Descalzo entre las agujas kársticas de Guangxi, China, Stafford debe aprender a navegar entre rocas afiladas y serpientes mortales para encontrar comida y refugio en este entorno con escasos recursos.

programme.title: Fear Factor: House of Fear
programme.desc: Nueve participantes enfrentan 24 horas de miedo ininterrumpido. Compiten apostando cuánto castigo pueden soportar en la retorcida subasta de dolor de Knoxville.

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo: náufragos
programme.desc: Con bengalas de emergencia iluminando el cielo, 12 veteranos de Supervivencia al desnudo se ven obligados a tomar lo que pueden y lanzarse al oscuro mar de Filipinas.

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo: solo
programme.desc: Shanika y James comienzan su desafío en solitario de 21 días. Mientras, devastada por los insectos, Terra considera volver a buscar el iniciador de fuego.

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo: solo
programme.desc: Jamie teme tener un parásito en la vejiga. Fernando cambia de estrategia de caza y James se encuentra con hipopótamos agresivos en su nueva fuente de agua.

programme.title: Desafío x2
programme.desc: Varados en medio de las llanuras de Zambia, Joe y Cody deben evitar a hipopótamos y elefantes para encontrar agua y refugio. La discusión de si deben dormir dentro del hueco de un árbol infestado de murciélagos podría dividir al equipo.

programme.title: A prueba de todo
programme.desc: Luego de hacer rapel en la imponente selva de Borneo, Bear Grylls descenderá por húmedos acantilados, luchará contra serpientes y sanguijuelas y hará frente a una lluvia torrencial para sobrevivir.

programme.title: Hombres del Ártico
programme.desc: Solo quedan tres semanas de la temporada de caza y los hombres se apresuran a recoger su bien más preciado, las pieles. Por un crudo invierno, los animales escasean y los hombres deben atrapar la mayor cantidad posible para obtener su piel.

programme.title: Operación Alaska
programme.desc: Los tres equipos continúan sus construcciones en ubicaciones únicas de Alaska y tienen que enfrentarse a vigas mal cortadas y pedidos cancelados.

programme.title: Alaska: hombres primitivos
programme.desc: Los hermanos aterrizan en Haines, Alaska, con la misión de encontrar una nueva casa para Noah. Bam y Gabe se proponen disuadir a los depredadores invasores hambrientos de la hibernación y Bear le presenta la cocina a Raiven.

programme.title: Alaska: hombres primitivos
programme.desc: Los hermanos Brown luchan contra los problemas del bote en Alaska mientras compiten para cumplir con una fecha límite. En Washington, Bam se esfuerza por ahorrar dinero en el rancho aprendiendo de un granjero.

programme.title: Sin fronteras con Ed Stafford
programme.desc: El objetivo de Ed es llegar a unos puntos circulares en medio del desierto de Danakil en Etiopía, el lugar más caluroso del mundo y con disputas fronterizas. Poco después de llegar las cosas empiezan a salir mal.

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo
programme.desc: Un aguerrido biólogo marino mexicano y un pescador vikingo noruego intentan sobrevivir 21 días en la naturaleza estadounidense. Luchan contra las lluvias torrenciales, la escasez de alimentos y un incendio catastrófico en su campamento.

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo: el último en pie
programme.desc: Los más habilidosos compiten por cien mil dólares y coronarse campeones del programa. Comienzan sin herramientas y se apresuran a prepararse para una tormenta. Luego, dos competidores comienzan a estar en riesgo.

programme.title: Desolado con Ed Stafford
programme.desc: Ed va al Círculo Polar Ártico en una zona montañosa cubierta de nieve, en los fiordos de Noruega.

programme.title: Naturaleza indomable
programme.desc: A medida que su mundo se derrite, los animales adaptados al frío deben cambiar su comportamiento para sobrevivir.

programme.title: Guerra dos tronos dos leopardos
programme.desc: Justo cuando regresa la calma, Tingana cae misteriosamente enfermo y deja su territorio sin protección. Es una situación potencialmente fatal, que asola al viejo duque y su legado. Mientras tanto, el joven Hosana.

programme.title: Mexicánicos
programme.sub-title: Jay de la Cueva + Land Rover
programme.desc: Jay de la Cueva, exlíder Moderatto, le pide a Martín Vaca renovar su Mustang 65 para acompañarlo en su nueva etapa como solista, incluyendo descubrir su color original y modernizar los interiores.

programme.title: Mexicánicos
programme.desc: Gera MX visita a Martín Vaca para personalizar un Mustang y regalarlo a un fan como parte de la promoción de su álbum Mustang 65. Mientras tanto, Martín y su equipo enfrentan el reto de convertir una Ford Lobo F159 en una carroza.

programme.title: Desolado con Ed Stafford
programme.desc: Ed Stafford da sus diez mejores consejos para sobrevivir diez días consecutivos, solo, en los ambientes más hostiles. Aislado y sin otra cosa que un equipo de rodaje, Ed ha aprendido que a veces lo inesperado nos trae recompensas.

programme.title: Desolado con Ed Stafford
programme.desc: Ed pone a prueba sus habilidades en los desiertos de Namibia. La temporada de sequía llega a su fin y Ed debe fortalecerse en el calor para cazar al jabalí.

programme.title: Ed Stafford: rituales del mundo
programme.desc: Ed conoce a los hamer, unos ganaderos etíopes, quienes tienen el ritual de saltar una fila de toros, para ser considerados hombres. Luego, él deberá domar a estos enormes animales, para saltar sobre ellos.

programme.title: La hora de la desaparición
programme.desc: Cuando todos los niños de la misma clase, menos uno, desaparecen misteriosamente la misma noche y exactamente a la misma hora, una comunidad se pregunta quién o qué está detrás de su desaparición.

programme.title: Teléfono negro 2
programme.desc: Mientras Finn, de 17 años, lidia con la vida tras su cautiverio, su hermana recibe llamadas en sueños del teléfono negro y ve visiones perturbadoras de tres chicos acechados en el campamento Lago Alpine.

programme.title: La mujer de las sombras
programme.desc: Es una mujer que aparece varias veces en el jardín delantero de una familia y, en muchas ocasiones, les da advertencias inquietantes. Los residentes empiezan a preguntarse quién es realmente ella y cuáles son sus verdaderas intenciones

programme.title: El destino final
programme.desc: Cuando Nick tiene una premonición de un accidente fatal durante una carrera de autos, logra salvarse junto a otros afortunados. Pero la muerte no cancela sus planes y comienza a cobrar una a una las vidas de los sobrevivientes.

programme.title: Dos contra el mundo
programme.desc: Dos policías corruptos de Nuevo México intentan chantajear a cada criminal que se cruza en su camino. Todo tomará un giro de lo más funesto cuando intenten intimidar a alguien que resulta ser más peligroso que ellos.

Una alianza de ciudades-estado retuvo al enemigo en uno de los enfrentamientos más famosos de la historia. El emperador Jerjes dirigió un ejército de más de cien mil hombres, y éste fue confrontado por trescientos espartanos.

programme.title: Mujer Maravilla 1984
programme.desc: En 1984, en plena Guerra Fría, Diana Prince, la Mujer Maravilla, se enfrenta al empresario Maxwell Lord y a su antigua amiga Barbara Minerva, conocida como Cheetah, una villana que posee fuerza y agilidad sobrehumanas.

programme.title: Wicked: Por siempre
programme.desc: Glinda y Elphaba deberán unirse una vez más. Con su singular amistad convertida en el punto de inflexión de su futuro, tendrán que mirarse a los ojos con honestidad para cambiar el destino de todo Oz.

programme.title: Escarabajo azul
programme.desc: Mientras busca su lugar en el mundo, Jaime Reyes encuentra biotecnología antigua que le otorga poderes impredecibles, cambiando su destino al convertirse en el superhéroe Blue Beetle.

programme.title: Duna
programme.desc: Paul Atreides, un joven brillante y talentoso, debe viajar a Arrakis, también llamado "Dune", que se ha convertido en el planeta más importante del universo. Su misión: asegurar el futuro de su familia y su pueblo.

programme.title: Duna - Parte dos
programme.desc: En su travesía mítica, Paul Atreides se alía con Chani y los fremen en busca de venganza y decide luchar por impedir un futuro terrible que solo él puede prever.

programme.title: La edad dorada
programme.desc: Mientras Ada, Marian y Aurora intentan proteger a Agnes del artículo del Ladies Home Journal, Bertha pone la mira en la cena presidencial.

programme.title: Mother Mary
programme.desc: Las heridas enterradas hace mucho tiempo salen a la superficie cuando la icónica estrella del pop Madre María se reúne con su distanciada mejor amiga y ex diseñador de vestuario, Sam Anselm, en vísperas de su actuación de regreso.

programme.title: Guerra
programme.desc: Al comenzar el juicio, Morgan se enfrenta a un interrogatorio incisivo por parte de Budgie sobre la participación de Carla en los inicios de Zephyr.

programme.title: Moonfall
programme.desc: Tras ser golpeada por un asteroide, la Luna ha salido de su órbita y se dirige hacia la Tierra; hecho que podría provocar la posible desaparición del planeta.

programme.title: Dragón rojo
programme.desc: Un investigador del FBI especializado en analizar la mente criminal, debe recurrir al caníbal Hannibal Lecter, a quien envió a la cárcel, para que lo ayude a capturar a un asesino serial.

programme.title: En busca de Harry: el arte detrás de la magia
programme.desc: Han pasado 25 años desde que el público recorrió por primera vez los pasillos de Hogwarts. Ahora, descubre al interior de la magnificencia y el meticuloso trabajo que hay detrás de la nueva serie de Harry Potter.

programme.title: Momias
programme.desc: Sigue a tres momias que terminan en el Londres actual y se embarcan en un viaje en busca de un antiguo anillo perteneciente a la familia real, robado por el ambicioso arqueólogo Lord Carnaby.

programme.title: Karate Kid: Leyendas
programme.desc: Daniel llega a Beijing, donde el Sr. Han lo ha estado buscando. Han tiene un nuevo protegido, Li Fong. Los dos mentores deben colaborar para instruir a Li Fong, pero queda por ver si sus enfoques educativos serán compatibles.

programme.title: Compañera perfecta
programme.desc: La muerte de un multimillonario desencadena una serie de acontecimientos para Iris y sus amigos durante un viaje de fin de semana a su finca junto al lago.

programme.title: Until Dawn: noche de terror
programme.desc: Un grupo pasa el fin de semana en un refugio de esquí. Se reúnen por el aniversario de la desaparición de sus amigos, sin saber que no están solos. Extrañas presencias los acompañarán en esta conmemoración.

programme.title: Super agente Hitpig!
programme.desc: Un cazarrecompensas porcino se encuentra recorriendo el mundo con un elefante libre de espíritu que inicialmente pretendía capturar.

programme.title: Spider-Man: de regreso a casa
programme.desc: Bajo la atenta mirada de su mentor Tony Stark, Peter Parker intenta mantener una vida normal, pero el nuevo villano Vulture interrumpe en su rutina diaria y, con él, lo más importante de la vida de Peter comenzará a verse amenazado.

programme.title: Harry Potter y el prisionero de Azkaban
programme.desc: Sirius Black ha escapado de la prisión de Azkaban y se encuentra tras los pasos de Harry. Junto a Ron, Hermione y un nuevo profesor, Harry enfrentará a Black y a los Dementores mientras trata de develar su misterioso pasado.

programme.title: Asesino por casualidad
programme.desc: Gary Johnson es el asesino profesional más buscado de Nueva Orleans. Cuando rompe el protocolo para ayudar a una mujer que intenta huir de un marido abusivo, se enamora de la mujer y coquetea con convertirse en un criminal.

programme.title: Pokémon: Detective Pikachu
programme.desc: En un mundo donde las personas recolectan Pokémon para luchar, un niño se encuentra con un Pikachu inteligente que habla y busca ser un detective.

programme.title: El Hombre Araña 3
programme.desc: Peter parece haber conseguido un equilibrio entre su relación con Mary Jane y sus responsabilidades como súperhéroe. Pero una tormenta amenaza en el horizonte: su traje cambia de repente, volviéndose negro y mejorando sus poderes.

programme.title: La casa del reloj en la pared
programme.desc: Lewis es un niño de diez años huérfano, que se muda a la vieja casa de su tío, la cual tiene un misterioso reloj. Su apacible y monótona vida se verá interrumpida cuando accidentalmente despierte a magos y brujas de un mundo secreto.

programme.title: Corazón de tinta
programme.desc: Meggie es una niña cuyo padre tiene la habilidad de volver reales los personajes de los cuentos. Una noche, un villano lo secuestra. Ahora Meggie, junto a amigos reales e imaginarios, emprenderá una búsqueda desesperada para salvarlo.

programme.title: La vida secreta de las mascotas
programme.desc: La vida de Max como mascota favorita corre peligro cuando aparece Duke, con quien Max pronto tiene sus diferencias. Pero deben amigarse cuando se enteran de que Snowball está reclutando a un ejército de animales domésticos abandonados.

programme.title: Las chicas superpoderosas
programme.desc: El profesor Utonio intenta crear una niña perfecta. Pero su travieso mono agrega a la fórmula un poco de una misteriosa sustancia y se produce una gran explosión de la que surgen tres niñas con increíbles superpoderes.

programme.title: Una chispa navideña
programme.desc: Molly, recientemente viuda, acepta a regañadientes el trabajo de dirigir un espectáculo navideño. Lo que no sabía es que se enamoraría de Hank, el protagonista y el soltero más codiciado de la ciudad.

programme.title: Harry Potter y la Orden del Fénix
programme.desc: Con su advertencia acerca del regreso de Lord Voldemort siendo ridiculizada, Harry y Dumbledore se convierten en el objetivo de las autoridades mágicas mientras que una autoritaria burócrata lentamente se apodera del mando en Hogwarts.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 2
programme.desc: Po, el panda convertido en Guerrero Dragón, y los Cinco Furiosos luchan contra Lord Shen, que quiere destruir la tradición del Kung fu y conquistar China. Mientras pelea, Po descubrirá su verdadero origen.

programme.title: El espantatiburones
programme.desc: Oscar es un pez al cual sus sueños siempre lo meten en líos. Quiere convertirse en rico y vivir en la cima del arrecife; Entonces aprovechará un encuentro con un tiburón para crear una mentira y así transformarse en El espanta tiburones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos: en la aldea perdida
programme.desc: En el desconocido Bosque Encantado, los Pitufos practican senderismo tratando de encontrar un pueblo legendario para su especie. Sin embargo, deberán apurarse a hacerlo para que el malvado mago Gargamel no se les adelante.

programme.title: Cómo entrenar a tu dragón
programme.desc: Un joven vikingo quiere unirse a la lucha contra los dragones que continuamente atacan su pueblo. En esta aventura se convierte en el inusual amigo de un joven dragón, y aprende que tienen más cosas en común de lo que pensaba.

programme.title: Shrek
programme.desc: Después de que su pantano se llenará de criaturas mágicas, un ogro solitario y gruñón llamado Shrek acepta la misión de rescatar a la bella princesa Fiona, que guarda un oscuro secreto, para que Lord Farquaad pueda casarse con ella.

programme.title: Shrek 2
programme.desc: Shrek y Fiona, convertida en ogro por amor, viajan a conocer a los padres de la joven, reyes de la mágica tierra de Muy, muy lejano. Horrorizados por el yerno, el rey prepara un complot para deshacerse de él.

programme.title: Mansiones en los árboles
programme.desc: Pete trabaja en la vivienda arbórea de una aventurera pareja de Alaska, para que no tengan que enfrentarse al frío de la montaña. Las cosas se calientan cuando instalan un sauna en la casa del árbol.

programme.title: Veterinarios de Texas

programme.title: Veterinarios de Texas
programme.desc: Bubby Cook, un adorable Basset Hound, tiene una condición que podría complicarle la cirugía al Dr. Ross. El Dr. Lavigne tiene dudas acerca de que su técnico lo asista en la cirugía de su propio perro.

programme.title: Guardianes de Texas

programme.title: Guardianes de Texas

programme.desc: El doctor Lavigne atiende a un bulldog francés con un problema para respirar que requiere una cirugía especial, luego se une al doctor Blue para transportar unos cerdos. Además, el doctor Ross examina su propio cerdo.

programme.title: Un vínculo especial

programme.title: Mi manada y yo

programme.title: Mi manada y yo
programme.desc: Lee está feliz de ver que el tímido sargento se siente más cómodo. Dos cabritos son los nuevos miembros de la manada. Bo, un labrador anciano, pasa tiempo divirtiéndose con Lee en la playa.

programme.title: Animales en riesgo: Houston

programme.title: Across the River and Into the Trees
programme.desc: Richard Cantwell es un coronel del ejército estadounidense, atormentado por la guerra, que se enfrenta a la noticia de que padece una enfermedad terminal con estoica indiferencia. Un encuentro casual con una joven revive en él la esperanza.

programme.title: Hoy se arregla el mundo
programme.desc: David, productor de televisión, descubre que no es el padre de su hijo de 9 años, Benito, a quien está muy unido. No obstante, le promete al pequeño que encontrará a su verdadero padre y, juntos, se embarcan en una aventura inolvidable.

programme.title: Terapia del amor
programme.desc: Bailey y Darla se embarcan en una forma de terapia en la que viajan por el país y vuelven a experimentar el pasado de Darla como una adicta al sexo.

programme.title: Harriet
programme.desc: La historia de Harriet Tubman, quien dirigió valientes misiones para llevar a los esclavos a la libertad, tras haber escapado ella misma en 1849.

programme.title: Recién casados
programme.desc: Durante su luna de miel por Europa, una pareja se enfrenta con amigos entrometidos, familias que los desaprueban y a la mala suerte.

programme.title: 10 jours sans maman
programme.desc: Antoine es el Jefe de recursos humanos de una gran empresa. Cuando su mujer decide irse de vacaciones y dejarle con la responsabilidad de sus cuatro hijos, intuye que será fácil. Pero Antoine ha subestimado el lío que esto puede suponer.

programme.title: Música, glamour y fama
programme.desc: Grace Davis es una leyenda del mundo de la música que vive en la ciudad de Los Ángeles. Cuando el mánager de Grace intenta darle un giro a su carrera, Grace y su asistente personal, Maggie, tendrán que tomar una importante decisión.

programme.title: Agentes del desorden
programme.desc: Dos amigos se visten como oficiales de policía para una fiesta de disfraces. Se ponen en peligro cuando se involucran con una red real de criminales y detectives sucios.

programme.title: Objetivo número uno
programme.desc: Un periodista de investigación intenta exponer la verdad detrás de una redada de heroína orquestada por policías corruptos para incriminar a un hombre inocente, condenado a cadena perpetua en una prisión tailandesa.

programme.title: Una ciudad despiadada
programme.desc: Cuando el huracán Katrina devasta Nueva Orleans, cuatro amigos desesperados se unen para llevar a cabo un atrevido atraco en el corazón de la ciudad.

programme.title: Yo, traidor
programme.desc: Un joven empresario trata de fundar una compañía pesquera en un remoto pueblo de la Patagonia, en Argentina, lo cual lo lleva a un doble conflicto con su familia y con los pescadores locales.

programme.title: Un cumpleaños problemático
programme.desc: Frank y sus amigos se reúnen en Palm Beach, Sídney, para celebrar el cumpleaños de Frank. Es un fin de semana de paseos en barco, risas y charlas hasta que se va imponiendo la realidad.

programme.title: Un amor inquebrantable
programme.desc: Después de estar bajo el agua durante más de 15 minutos, un niño de 14 años de Misuri lucha por su vida mientras sus padres adoptivos y su pastor permanecen junto a su cama y rezan por un milagro.

programme.title: En sus zapatos
programme.desc: Maggie y Rose son dos hermanas huérfanas que no se parecen en nada, excepto que calzan el mismo número de calzado. Maggie es guapa, alegre y tiene éxito entre los hombres. Exactamente lo contrario de su hermana Rose.

programme.title: Ophelia
programme.desc: Ofelia forma parte de las personas de confianza de la reina Gertrudis y su personalidad logra conquistar rápidamente al príncipe Hamlet. Después del asesinato del rey, Ofelia deberá contener a las altas esferas del poder danés.

programme.title: La noche de su vida
programme.desc: Durante su discurso de graduación, el estudiante Denis declara su amor por Beth Cooper, la chica más popular en la escuela. Para sorpresa de Denis, el mismo día Beth aparece en la puerta de su casa para ofrecerle la mejor noche de su vida.

programme.title: Victor Frankenstein
programme.desc: Igor Strausman, el asistente del doctor Víctor Frankenstein, intenta proteger al brillante científico de sí mismo cuando pierde el control con sus arriesgados experimentos, y vulnera los límites de lo ético y de lo racional.

programme.title: No soy tu mami
programme.desc: Paula, una periodista que integra una revista, decide escribir sobre maternidad para aumentar las ventas y salvar el proyecto. Ella expresa y fundamenta por qué no desea ser madre, pero los resultados no son los esperados.

programme.title: The Menu
programme.desc: Una joven pareja viaja a una exclusiva isla para degustar el menú de un chef mundialmente aclamado. Sin embargo, el chef ha introducido un ingrediente secreto que sorprenderá a los comensales.

programme.title: Días perrunos
programme.desc: Unos adorables perros comienzan a influir en las carreras, las amistades y los romances de una presentadora, un paseador, un empresario y otras personas de Los Ángeles.
